storyline.real: Berger leads from pole on two stops against Fisichella's one-stopping Jordan. Fisichella leads between Berger's stops; Berger rejoins behind him after his second stop on lap 34 and passes him again at the second chicane on the same lap. Fisichella's left-rear tyre fails with six laps to go, and Berger wins by 17.5 s from Michael Schumacher.

eras.briefing: Hockenheim, 1997. Berger took pole, 0.023 s ahead of Fisichella's Jordan. You run Berger, leading Fisichella by 11.8 s after 14 laps, with Benetton planning two stops. Keep the Jordan behind you to the flag.
